نستبين (form X)
# نَسْتَبِينُ (nastabīnu) /nas.ta.biː.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبَانَ (istabāna)
# نَسْتَبِينَ (nastabīna) /nas.ta.biː.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَبَانَ (istabāna)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
